caption.text:
Jaksa Agung Muda Tindak Pidana Khusus (Jampidsus) Kejaksaan Agung, Febrie Adriansyah, muncul pertama kali ke publik di tengah penyidikan yang dilakukan Korps Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Korupsi (Kortastipidkor) Polri. Ia meminta publik tidak berspekulasi terkait penggeledahan di sejumlah lokasi, salah satunya temuan berkilo-kilo emas dan miliaran yang dalam rumah di kawasan Sentul, Kabupaten Bogor, terkait tiga perkara dugaan korupsi pada Rabu (8/7).

"Bagaimana ada uang yang ditemukan di rumah Sentul, itu ada yang punya, ada yang punya, ada kegiatannya, orang-orang kegiatan bisa ditanya, ya, ada bangunannya, bisa nanti dicek. Tetapi tentunya ini tidak akan dijelaskan saat ini, namun akan dijelaskan dalam satu proses acara yang benar. Paham?" kata Febrie di Kejaksaan Agung, Jakarta Selatan, Jumat (10/7).

Selain itu, dia juga merespons soal tudingan kaitan dirinya dengan kasus dugaan korupsi batu bara PLTU yang menyebabkan blackout di Sumatera-Jawa-Kalimantan. Menurutnya, sebaiknya ada audit keseluruhan terlebih dahulu, baik mengenai jumlah kebutuhan, kualitas yang masuk, transaksi pembelian, dan prosedur pengadaannya.

“Saya juga tidak paham ada keterkaitan Jampidsus dengan blackout. Nanti kita tunggu lah proses bagaimana rekan-rekan penyidik nanti ya menyampaikan apa masalahnya keterkaitan blackout tersebut, ya, perkaranya perkara apa, tapi saya baca-baca itu terkait dengan pengadaan baru bara ke PLTU," ujarnya.

📸: Dok. kumparan/Aditya.

caption.text_translation:
Special Crimes Young Prosecutor General (Jampidsus) Attorney General, Febrie Adriansyah, appears to the public for the first time amid investigation conducted by the Anti-Corruption Crimes Corps (Kortastipidkor) Police. He asks the public not to speculate regarding searches in a number of locations, one of them was the discovery of kilos of gold and billions inside a house in Sentul area, Bogor Region, in relation to three cases of alleged corruption on Wednesday (8/7).

"How there is money found in Sentul's house, it is someone who has it, there is an activity, the activity people can be asked, yes, there is a building, can be checked later. But of course this will not be explained now, but will be explained in one true process of events. Understand? " said Febrie at the Supreme Prosecutor, South Jakarta, Friday (10/7).

In addition, he also responded to the allegations of his connection with the alleged PLTU coal corruption case that caused the blackout in Sumatera-Jawa-Kalimantan. According to him, there should be an overall audit first, both regarding the quantity of needs, the quality entered, the purchase transactions, and the procedure of its acquisition.

"I also don't understand if Jampidsus has a connection with blackout. Later we will wait for the process of how the fellow investigators will later convey what is the problem of the relevance of the blackout, yes, what is the matter, but I'm reading about it is related to the procurement of new coal to PLTU," he said.

 📸: Dok. kumparan/Aditya.
